newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Austral Coal in US$90 mln hedging facility.
newsitem.headline: Austral Coal in US$90 mln hedging facility.

text.p: Austral Coal Ltd said on Friday it has executed a US$90 million foreign exchange hedging facility with Rothschild Australia Ltd.

This is an interim facility allowing the company to hedge up to about 80 percent of coal revenues over the next 18 months, it said, adding that it has currently sold forward US$61 million at a rate of US$0.758.
The Australian dollar was trading around US$0.7519/24 on Friday afternoon.
Austral Coal bought the Tahmoor colliery from Kembla Coal and Coke in February 1997 and took over the majority of KCC's existing Tahmoor coal supply contracts.
Austral shares were steady at 54 cents at 3.00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Friday.
